visual_identity.color_palette: Bright amber-orange base with three thin horizontal white 'speed streaks' from neck to tail; cream-colored underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Soft, downy feather covering across the body; long pennaceous feathers on the forearms forming primitive wing-structures; smooth beak texture.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Large, dark, glassy bird-like eyes; a streak of crimson-red 'mohawk' feathers running from the crown down the nape.

anatomy_constraints.head: Small, toothless beak; large expressive eyes; slender S-curve neck.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Very long, thin legs optimized for sprinting; three-toed bird-like feet; long arms with three slender fingers held in a tight tuck.
anatomy_constraints.body: Aerodynamic, lightweight frame; tail held straight and rigid as a horizontal counterweight.

visual_logic.subject: A high-strung, twitchy Ornithomimus in a mid-bolt sprint pose.
visual_logic.action: Navigating through low-altitude coastal humidity, kicking up dark organic mud.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the grey and dark green tones of a coastal lowland marsh with cycad palms and muddy estuaries.

personality: The 'Sprint Specialist'—high-strung, alert, and lightning-fast. Always looks like he's about to bolt at the slightest sound.
